tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Find online stores on CouponBricks by name (e.g. "helium 10", "saunaspace"). Returns the store name, its slug for get_coupons, how many live offers it has, and its coupon page.

tools.name: get_coupons
tools.description: Live coupon codes and deals for one store, best first: exclusive codes, then codes our team verified most recently. Each offer has the discount, what it applies to, the date our team last verified it at checkout, and either a code to type at checkout or a link the shopper must open first.
